subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: CPFR
description: A micro-lesson that makes CPFR usable.

hook.text: A retailer and its supplier share the same forecast. When demand shifts, both adjust in sync—no surprises.

buildup.text: CPFR—Collaborative Planning, Forecasting, and Replenishment—is a partnership model between buyers and sellers.

discovery.text: Partners share demand data, align forecasts, and coordinate replenishment to reduce waste on both sides.

twist.text: CPFR requires trust and data sharing. Many companies resist revealing sales data to trading partners.

climax.text: Walmart and Procter & Gamble's CPFR partnership is a textbook example—cutting stockouts and excess inventory.

punchline.text: Share the forecast. Split the savings. Win together.
